bio: Fourth-year S1 Informatika student at Telkom University, working across two areas. In medical imaging: bone scan analysis published in Knowledge-Based Systems and the International Journal of Intelligent Engineering and Systems, a first-author benchmark paper accepted at the Journal of Imaging Informatics in Medicine, and a chest X-ray platform shipping as web and desktop apps. In industrial AI: a production inference service for mining fleet dashcams, and provider-aware retrieval for B2B travel inventory that won the Travlr Data Challenge. 2nd place at GEMASTIK 2026. GPA 4.0/4.0. Graduating May 2027.
